Greenzie | Robotics Software Engineer (Early Career + Experienced) | Atlanta, GA | ONSITE/HYBRID | Full-time | https://greenzie.applytojob.com/apply Greenzie builds the autonomy software that runs on commercial mowers. We don't sell the iron — Wright, Mean Green, Bobcat, and Greenworks Commercial do, with our stack on them. Mission is to free humans from repetitive outdoor labor. The software is on hundreds of machines in the field today. We're hiring roboticists who want production robots doing real outdoor work, not lab demos. C++, Python, ROS/ROS2. You will own (or learn) a subsystem, debug messy field data, and ship to machines that mow for a living. - Robotics Software Engineer | Early Career (0–3 yrs): https://greenzie.applytojob.com/apply/zaDr7OyOmj/Robotics-So... 
- Robotics Software Engineer | Experienced (3–6 yrs): https://greenzie.applytojob.com/apply/UdRcDlWSzs/Robotics-So... Also open in Atlanta: Technical Service Coordinator. Apply on those pages and mention HN. Questions: cbq@greenzie.com
